# Kodland

> Kodland is an online educational platform offering project-based digital skills training for children ages 8-17, including programming languages like Python and game development with Unity.

Kodland provides tutored courses in digital skills with a focus on hands-on learning and student progress tracking. The platform serves a global audience with support channels and transparent pricing information.

## Key Topics

- Digital Skills
- Project-Based Learning
- Python Programming
- Unity Game Development
- Kids Learning (Ages 8-17)
- Online Tutoring
- Course Offerings
- Pricing
- Trial Lessons
- Student Progress Tracking
- Educational Platform
- Class Format
- Teaching Methods

- [About Kodland](https://www.kodland.org/about): Kodland's mission and educational platform for teaching digital skills to children ages 8-17
